name: Cornwall
about: Stays walkable nearly year-round, just wetter and windier in winter.
overview: England's mildest corner, warmed by the Gulf Stream — palm trees despite the latitude, real surfing around Newquay, and a coastal path linking fishing villages.
costOverview: Cornwall runs pricier than much of England outside London — even a Cornish pasty and a cream tea cost more here than the same items inland, reflecting the seaside tourist premium.
